title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Uzbekistan, of the other part
part_context: Commends the long-standing and strategic relationship between the EU and Uzbekistan, as well as the increasing cooperation and exchanges in various formats; reiterates the EU’s commitment to working together with the country, and with the EU’s partners in Central Asia, to ensure peace, security, democracy, stability, prosperity, human rights protection, media freedom, climate justice and sustainable development;
